description: A FastAPI application defining an endpoint for updating or creating items with specified item_id. The endpoint supports PUT requests, accepts request bodies with optional 'name' and 'size' fields, and responds with the updated or created item.

methods.name: upsert_item( item_id: str, name: Annotated[Union[str, None], Body()] = None, size: Annotated[Union[int, None], Body()] = None, )
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing item or create a new one if it does not exist. Accepts item_id, and optional 'name' and 'size' fields in the request body, updates the 'items' dictionary accordingly, and returns the item or a JSONResponse with status 201 if created.
